newsitem.title: USA: Guidant gets approval to test stent.
newsitem.headline: Guidant gets approval to test stent.

text.p: Medical device manufacturer Guidant Corp said Monday it had received approval from the S. Food and Drug Administration to test a coronary stent system used to treat clogged arteries.

Stents are metal tubes or coils that are mounted on a dilatation catheter, which is inflated to expand the stent in the artery. When the catheter is removed from the artery, the stent stays in place, which provides a "mechanical" way of keeping the artery open.
Guidant said clinical trials will begin immediately. The ACS RX MULTI-LINK Coronary Stent Delivery System was evaluated and approved for marketing in Europe earlier this year.
Shares of Guidant were up 5/8 to 51-1/2.
